t1 test() {
	<!-- This is a comment -->
	// This is not included in the output.
	<div>Some standard t1</div>
	/* This is not included in the output too. */

		Leave this alone.
	*/
}
-- out --

t1 test() {
	<!-- This is a comment -->
	// This is not included in the output.
	<div>Some standard t1</div>
	/* This is not included in the output too. */

		Leave this alone.
